ctx.x: So anyway, I said go on get a little taste. Everybody got a little taste, and we did another one. So we were through with the whole date in about three quarters of an hour. Well, all the whiskey hadn't gone by then, and so I says, well there's nothing more that we can do with this one, and everybody started packing their instruments up and getting the last drink and went on home and we were out of there in about forty-five minutes. And I told them, I said now, we did about four playbacks I'd say, and I said A, B…
